name: Window Alarm
disable: DC 40 Thievery check (master) to carefully scuff the faint runes around the window's edge

items.name: Signal the Keys
items.text:
Trigger The window is broken or is unlocked and opened without using one of the shop keys

---
Effect Each person carrying a shop key within 500 feet receives a mental image of the area 10 feet around the window for 1 minute.

text: Transparent runes around the window's edge trigger a silent alarm shortly after being opened by an unauthorized person.
